services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Power cut, blown fuses, or burnt-out circuits? We arrive quickly to diagnose the fault and restore power safely. Most calls resolved same day.

services.title: Boiler and Heating Electrics
services.desc: Installation, repair, and fault-finding on electric boilers, immersion heaters, and heating controls. Full diagnostic service included.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fusebox or trip-prone electrics? We replace worn consumer units with modern, safer alternatives that reduce trip-outs.

services.title: Fault Finding and Testing
services.desc: Can't find where that intermittent fault is coming from? We carry diagnostic equipment to trace faults quickly and pinpoint the cure.

services.title: Periodic Inspections & EICRs
services.desc: Landlord safety checks or pre-sale electrics test. We issue full reports and certificates to keep your property compliant and insurable.

services.title: New Installations and Extensions
services.desc: New circuits, sockets, lighting, or outdoor electrics. We design safely around your needs and test everything before handover.

about_pullquote: I started this because I got tired of seeing customers ripped off by cowboys on the driveway.
about_para_1: Right Spark was founded on the simple principle: turn up on time, fix it properly, charge a fair price. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation across Liverpool by being honest about what's wrong and what it'll cost to put right. We're NICEIC-certified and fully insured, which means your home is protected and your electrics meet current Building Regulations.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, explain what's happening in plain English, and don't try to sell work you don't need. Whether it's a midnight power failure or a planned rewire, we bring the same care and attention. That's why so many of our jobs come from word-of-mouth and repeat calls.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Customers Say About Right Spark

reviews.text: Called at 11pm on a Sunday with no power downstairs. They picked up straight away and were at my house by midnight. Turned out to be a faulty socket that the previous sparky had fitted wrong. Fixed in 20 minutes and wouldn't charge me call-out fees because they got it done so quick. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had an EICR done before selling. The surveyor flagged concerns but Right Spark explained exactly what needed doing. They rewired the kitchen and two bedrooms without any faffing about. Very professional, clean, and the price was honest. Really pleased.
reviews.author: Claire P.

reviews.text: Been using them for years now. Every time there's a fault they diagnose it straight — no trying to sell me stuff I don't need. Recently upgraded our consumer unit and they did it all on the same afternoon. Reliable and fair-priced. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David R.
